texts.preamble: Pankaj Kumar Rawal & Anr. vs . State Of Rajasthan & Anr. on 24 April, 2015 Author: Vijay Bishnoi Bench: Vijay Bishnoi 1 S.B. Criminal Misc. Petition No.1023/2015 Pankaj Kumar Rawal & Anr. Vs. State of Rajasthan & Anr. Date of order : 24.04.2015 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vijay Bishnoi Mr. Bhavit Sharma for the petitioners. Mr. O.P. Rathi, Public Prosecutor. This criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners being aggrieved with the order dated 14.3.2015 whereby the Additional District Magistrate-cum- Adjudicating Officer, Sirohi has imposed a fine of Rs.50,000/- upon each of the petitioners in the proceedings under clause (ii) of Sub-Section (2) of Section 26 and Sections 51 and 52 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.arguments: It is contended that as per the report of Food Analyst, the packet of food items do not contain common name or INS number of artificial flavouring substance used in the product. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it was the duty of the manufacturer only to display the common name or INS number on the packed food.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It is contended that as per the report of Food Analyst, the packet of food items do not contain common name or INS number of artificial flavouring substance used in the product. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it was the duty of the manufacturer only to display the common name or INS number on the packed food.
